svg.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Match declarations first; check image requirements at acquire
svg.desc: The router checks the spec against static backend declarations at tool attachment. A fixed guest or runtime has its advertised behavior verified in conformance tests. A backend receiving an image per spec checks image-dependent requirements on the actual sandbox at acquisition. Successful command checks are cached per physical instance; newly required checks and replacement instances need fresh checks. Failed checks refuse the workload. A compatibility check grants no additional authority.
svg.text: Match declarations first; check image requirements at acquire
OsFamily chooses path and command grammar. It does not list installed tools.
Verify advertised behavior with its real conformance suite.
Acquire the actual sandbox and check required commands or file access.
Refuse incompatible requirements before running the workload.
Cache successful command checks for this physical instance.
A probe establishes compatibility; it never authorizes a more privileged operation.
Commands can change after the check. Confinement and operation-level checks still apply.
